title: Lake|Front Serenity | WaterColor Rental | Exclusive 30A
meta_description: Stay at Lake-Front Serenity, a peaceful retreat in WaterColor. Ideal for a serene and picturesque vacation.
description_expanded: $250 Concierge Credit for Summer! Receive a $250 credit to use on concierge services for arrivals May 23, 2026 - August 8, 2026 if you book by August 8, 2026 when you use code LAKEFRONT250 at check-out* Lake-Front Serenity Peaceful Water Views in the Heart of WaterColor ________________________________________ Home Introduction Unwind in style at Lake-Front Serenity , a beautifully appointed 5BR/4.5BA retreat nestled in the heart of WaterColor . With serene water views, expansive wraparound porches, a 6-seater LSV, and 4 Taxi bikes, this elegant coastal home offers the perfect blend of luxury, comfort, and convenience-just minutes from Camp WaterColor and the beach . Home Highlights 6-Seater LSV (Golf Cart) - Complimentary Access included with stay (waiver required; restrictions apply) 4 Taxi Bikes - Serviced regularly by La Dolce Vita Water Views from Multiple Rooms and Outdoor Spaces Wraparound Front Porch + Wraparound Balcony with Lounge Areas and Ceiling Fans Gas Grill + Outdoor Dining for 10 3rd Floor Loft - Foosball table, seating areas, and TV (accessed via spiral staircase) Gourmet Kitchen - Stainless appliances, Keurig + drip coffee makers, wet bar and standalone ice maker 2nd Floor Main Living Area - Fireplace, sound bar, Smart TV with streaming and pond views Dining for 14 - Table seating for 8 + breakfast bar for 6 Office Nook - 1st floor workspace ideal for remote work or school Sleeping for 12 Guests - 2 King Suites + 2 Queen Suites + Bunk Room HE Washer and Dryer + Mini Fridge (1st Floor) Outdoor Shower - Hot and cold water Driveway Parking for 2 Vehicles + Garage Parking for LSV (no street parking) Access to WaterColor Beach Club, Camp WaterColor and Community Pools (for 12 guests ages 5+) Location Perks 1-Minute Bike Ride to Camp WaterColor Easy Access to WaterColor Beach Club and Community Pools (heated seasonally) Scenic Pond Setting in the Heart of WaterColor Quick Bike or LSV Ride to Beach Access, Dining and Shopping Know Before You Go Summer rentals are Saturday-Saturday only. Nightly (with seasonal minimums) and weekly rates available during other times of year. Access to WaterColor amenities is included for up to 12 guests ages 5 and older. Strict No Pet Policy due to allergies - unauthorized animals will result in fines and possible eviction plus deep cleaning fees. A mid-stay clean is required for reservations of 10+ days (included in rate). Additional cleans available for a fee. Street parking is prohibited. Neighborhood parking is first come, first serve for up to 2 additional vehicles. * One promotion or discount per reservation. Promotions or discounts cannot be combined
rooms_guidance: 1st Floor King Suite 1 | TV, ensuite bath with double vanity sinks, walk-in shower and soaking tub, walk-in closet, private covered patio with seating.

1st Floor Queen Suite 1 | View of pond, TV, ensuite bath with shower/tub combo, walk-in closet plus dresser storage, private entrance to wrap around front porch with two seating areas.
